isolatedSessions.semantics: Each preview terminal id owns an independent shell runtime, cwd, environment, transcript, foreground command, input listeners, and terminal size.

cwdAndEnvironment.semantics: Session-local cd/export/unset state; host process start messages carry an absolute normalized cwd and validated environment names.

streamingStdio.semantics: Allowlisted production Worker commands stream separate stdout/stderr chunks through HostProcessTable into the preview xterm; package workflow commands remain direct workflow adapters.

ptyLineDiscipline.semantics: Worker processes can opt into bounded canonical input, local echo, backspace and line-kill editing, Ctrl-D EOF, and Ctrl-C virtual SIGINT; legacy raw streaming remains the default.

terminalResize.semantics: Resize is retained per session and delivered through the host protocol, but no kernel ioctl/termios PTY exists.

foregroundProcess.semantics: One active command per terminal is tracked and receives stdin/resize/signal events; process groups and job control are unsupported.

exitStatus.semantics: Completion records exit code; virtual SIGINT/SIGTERM/SIGKILL fallbacks use 130/143/137.

lifecycleRecovery.semantics: Production Worker close, teardown, listener cleanup, generation rejection, resource release, and fresh-session restart are covered in Chrome and unit tests.

signals.semantics: SIGINT/SIGTERM are cooperative with a bounded grace period before Worker termination; SIGKILL terminates immediately. These are virtual signals, not Unix kernel delivery.

processListAndKill.semantics: The preview UI reads active PID/generation/cwd/argv/TTY state from HostProcessTable and offers interrupt/terminate/kill; retained history and POSIX process groups are unsupported.

portListAndStop.semantics: The Ports panel lists and stops preview workflow ports.

packageScriptArguments.semantics: npm/pnpm/yarn supported script arguments remain argv entries.

projectLocalBin.semantics: The shell resolves registered PATH entries and recognizes pinned Node shebang fixtures; it is not arbitrary executable or native-binary execution.

boundedBackpressure.semantics: The production Worker gates output on HostProcessTable acknowledgements, delays stdin credit acknowledgement until output admission, and caps retained host/shell/transcript bytes and scheduler callbacks.

commandSecurity.semantics: Commands resolve through an explicit registry/project PATH mapping; start messages carry immutable argv arrays, validated cwd/env, and never join input into a native shell command.
